title: E-signature in practice
intro: Your PIN and your signature are yours alone. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Call: certificate expires today

artifact.name: MöhürID Support
body: Hello, this is MöhürID support. Your mobile signature certificate, excuse me, expires today and will be blocked unless you renew it.

options.label: I will call the official number myself

decisions.explain: Find the service's number on its official website yourself.

decisions.title: MöhürID: Signature request
decisions.explain: A request you did not start means someone is trying to use your name.

decisions.title: Caller asks for the SMS code

artifact.name: MöhürID Support
body: You will get an SMS for the renewal. Read me the code and I will enter it in the system for you.

options.label: I do not share codes with anyone

decisions.explain: Real support never asks for a code.

decisions.title: Code after your own sign-in
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or dangerous?

artifact.name: MohurID
body: Confirmation code: 482913. Do not share this code. If you did not send this request, reject it.

decisions.explain: A normal message when you sign in yourself. No link, and it reminds you to keep the code secret.

decisions.title: Blocked certificate text
decisions.prompt: Is this message safe or dangerous?

artifact.name: MohurID
body: Your certificate is blocked. Restore it here: mohurid-yenile.test

decisions.explain: The link does not go to the service's official website. Open the official site yourself to check.
